title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
### **Description**

As a Quality Assurance Analyst at Infor, you will have a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality enterprise applications that meet the evolving needs of our global customers. You’ll collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and customer success teams to validate functionality, performance, and scalability—helping us deliver smarter, faster, and more intuitive software.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Develop, document, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and user stories.
* Perform manual and automated testing across web-based and cloud-native applications.
* Identify, log, and track defects using tools such as JIRA, collaborating with development to ensure timely resolution.
* Work in Agile/Scrum teams to ensure continuous testing, integration, and delivery pipelines.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Development, Business Analysis, Product Management and UX teams to understand application use cases, industry-specific workflows, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Participate in user story reviews and contribute to requirements clarification and risk assessment.
* Monitor application performance, usability, and stability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Contribute to the enhancement of QA best practices, frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure quality of release builds in all environments until production. Participate in release sign-off

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* B.Tech/B.E or an equivalent degree in CSE or a relevant stream
* 2-3 years of relevant experience in software quality assurance, preferably in enterprise software or cloud environments.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or TestComplete, Playwright
* Experience of SQL, APIs, and data validation.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Jenkins.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills
* Analytical thinking and attention to detail
* Experience with version control tools like Git
* Understanding of any programming or scripting language – Java, C, Python, Go, Ruby
* Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience testing Cloud and Web applications
* Understanding of Cloud Design principles – Scalability, Reliability, Elasticity

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Understanding of Canonical Modelling and Ontology
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles.
* Experience working with AI tools

### **About Infor**

**About Infor**

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60,000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business-wide digital transformation.  
  
For more information visit www.infor.com

title: QA Engineer - AI Systems III
description:
**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

We're looking for an AI Engineer who is passionate about both building AI-powered applications and ensuring they work reliably in production. This role combines AI engineering with quality engineering, focusing on developing LLM-based solutions while creating automated testing and evaluation frameworks to measure quality, accuracy, safety, and performance. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to deliver AI solutions that are not only innovative, but also measurable, stable, and production-ready.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* AI Engineering: Build and maintain AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agent-based workflows.
* Develop integrations with foundation models and AI services using Python and modern AI frameworks.

* Design prompt workflows, structured outputs, tool calling, and retrieval-based systems.
* Build APIs, backend services, and internal tools using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI solutions.
* AI Quality & Automation Design and execute automated test suites for AI applications and agentic workflows.
* Create and maintain evaluation datasets, benchmark scenarios, and regression test cases.
* Build pipelines to measure response quality, hallucinations, accuracy, latency, and cost.

- Implement LLM-as-a-judge evaluations and automated scoring frameworks using tools such as DeepEval, RAGAS, or PromptFoo.

* Develop AI-powered test generation for functional, edge-case, and negative testing scenarios.
* Perform adversarial testing including prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and safety validation.
* Monitor production AI systems through logging, tracing, and quality dashboards.
* Work with engineering teams to establish quality gates before AI features are released.

  

**Required Qualifications:**  
- 2- 4 years of software engineering, QA automation, AI engineering, or related experience.

* Strong Python and Golang programming skills and understanding of software engineering fundamentals.
* Familiarity with LLM applications, prompt engineering, RAG, or agent-based AI systems.
* Experience in test automation using frameworks such as PyTest or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of API testing, backend services, and REST architectures.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation concepts such as hallucination detection, response quality measurement, benchmark testing, and regression testing.
* Experience with SQL and basic cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Why Proofpoint?**

At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us:

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits
* Career success on your terms
* Flexible work environment
* Annual wellness and community outreach days
* Always on recognition for your contributions
* Global collaboration and networking opportunities

**Our Culture:**

Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success-every day, for everyone.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com.

**How to Apply**

Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information- we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Intern - QA
description:
About Us:

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview:

TRC Companies is looking for a passionate and curious **Intern** to join our **Advanced Energy (AE) Technology Group** within **POWER Sector** in **India**. This internship is designed for recent graduates who are interested in building a career in Software Quality Assurance and Test Automation.

As an Intern, you will work alongside experienced QA Engineers and Developers to learn software testing fundamentals, automation frameworks, API testing, and modern quality engineering practices. This is an excellent opportunity to gain real-world experience in software development and testing while contributing to product quality.

Responsibilities:

* Learn and understand application functionality, business requirements, and user workflows.
* Create and execute manual test cases to validate software functionality.
* Assist in identifying, documenting, and tracking software defects.
* Participate in functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing activities.
* Learn and contribute to automated test script development under the guidance of senior team members.
* Support web application and API testing efforts.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA engineers to ensure product quality.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Assist in maintaining test documentation and test execution reports.
* Continuously learn and adopt software testing and automation best practices.

Qualifications:

* Recent graduate or currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of software development concepts.
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or C#.
* Basic Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts.
* Basic knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and tools.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

**Duration:**

* 3-6 Months (with potential for extension or pre-placement consideration based on performance)

**Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills:**

* Academic, personal, or project experience involving software testing or automation
* Familiarity with Git or version control systems.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Exposure to automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of API concepts and testing tools such as Postman.
* Exposure to Agile methodologies through coursework or projects.

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Software Testing Fundamentals
* Test Automation using modern frameworks
* Web and API Testing
* Defect Tracking and Root Cause Analysis
* Agile Development Practices
* Version Control and Collaborative Development
* Industry-standard Quality Engineering Practices

**#LI-VK1**

  
EEO Statement:

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

title: QA Engineer II
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.





**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Work with Connect and CRM Ops, and learn how a whole team test approach works in practice

* Take part in quality practices such as "3 amigos" sessions, bug bashes, incident learning reviews, testability reviews and operability reviews

* Join discussions on technical decisions and ask questions that improve testability

* Collaborate with your teammates to identify and automate the appropriate tests

* Exploratory test with the team and help uncover unexpected risks

* Contribute to a fast, reliable pipeline that gives feedback on every change as it moves towards production

* Collaborate with Design, Product and Customer Success to better understand our customers and help manage customer incidents

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Experience (or an industry placement / bootcamp could be considered) in a software testing or quality role

* Experience with exploratory testing, or a clear willingness to build that skill on the job

* Interest in applying different techniques, tools and approaches based on context

* Curiosity about testing technically complex systems, and comfort learning them with support

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Passionately team-oriented and collaborative

* Comfortable learning new technologies and systems

**AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE**

* A first experience writing or maintaining automated tests

* Knowledge of when and when not to use automation in testing

* Exposure to Continuous Delivery or CI pipelines

* Interest in Testing in Production, Reliability, Security or Performance testing

* Testing Community Involvement





**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION** : ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com** .

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

#LI-HYBRID

description:

SQL (Advanced querying, analytical functions)

Exposure to Microsoft Azure and cloud data platforms

Python

Experience testing data pipelines and reporting solutions end-to-end Exposure to Microsoft Power BI / analytics platforms.
